Reduction in provision
of ₹66.00 lakh was the
net effect of increase of
₹17.00 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of ₹67.00
lakh and surrender of
₹16.00 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need of
additional amount in
payment for legal
charges and medical
reimbursement.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Final saving of ₹433.03
lakh is understated by
₹0.14 lakh due to
clearance of OB
suspense. Reasons for
actual final saving of
₹433.17 lakh have not
been intimated (July
2025).
